jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Core Platform
jobs.content: <h3>About the Role</h3><p>We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with 4-6 years of experience building highly scalable distributed systems using Python and PostgreSQL. You will design, develop, and maintain mission-critical APIs.</p><h4>Requirements</h4><ul><li>4+ years experience in Python and microservices</li><li>Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and SQL</li><li>Experience with Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines</li></ul><h4>Perks</h4><p>Competitive salary, RSUs, comprehensive medical insurance, annual wellness bonus.</p>
